environment.description:
Connection environment with the financial provider.

`production`: Production.
`homologation`: Homologation

* This field will be ignored in our Sandbox environment

apis.description:
APIs enabled for the financial provider.

`charge/bank_billet`: boleto.
`charge/pix`: Pix.
`payment`: Payment.
`transfer`: Transfer

revalidate.description: Revalidates credentials with the financial provider. If passed true, the connection will only be changed if the credentials and permissions are valid.
